quick_facts.sprint_goal: Stand up authentication and store management — the two foundational modules that every other feature depends on.

content.tldr: Sprint 1 builds the foundation: JWT auth with RBAC, and store-scoped multi-tenancy. Nothing else can be built without these two modules.

features_committed.title: Authentication & RBAC
features_committed.rationale: Every endpoint requires a logged-in user with a role. This blocks the entire backlog.

features_committed.title: Store Management
features_committed.rationale: All data (products, orders, invoices) is scoped to a store. Required before any business entities.

dependencies: Backend scaffolding (NestJS app, TypeORM config, Docker Compose) must be created this sprint as prerequisite
risks: Vietnamese tax compliance rules for invoices are complex — deliberately deferred to Sprint 3 to allow research time

what_went_well: Both features (auth + store) delivered within sprint. Zero carryover.
11 unit tests green on first build pass.
JWT + Redis refresh token rotation implemented correctly per security rules.
taxCode immutability and deactivation session flush both working.
what_to_improve: Wiki progress.json files were not updated in real time during implementation — closed retroactively at sprint end.
vibe-git branch was not created before implementation code was written (retroactive branch recovery used). Enforce HARD GATE next sprint.
action_items: Sprint 2: run vibe-git BEFORE any code changes — no exceptions.
Sprint 2: update progress.json task-by-task as work is completed, not in batch at end.

audit.author: vibe-project-manager
audit.note: Sprint 1 closed. Velocity: 2/2. All 15 tasks across auth + store marked done. 11 tests green. Build passing. Retrospective written. wiki progress files updated.

audit.author: vibe-product-owner
audit.note: Sprint 1 plan created by PM decision. Dependency-ordered: auth first, then store.
